view.description: workspaces: only the change workspaces (networks with a parent), each with its creator, created time, retention and snapshot counts by trigger for the page asked for; latest: every network with its newest PROCESSED snapshot id, time and device count for the page asked for

x-values.networks: every network the login can see (default)
x-values.workspaces: only the change workspaces, with creator, retention and snapshot counts by trigger for the page asked for
x-values.primary: the networks that are not change workspaces (no parent)
x-values.latest: every network, each with its newest PROCESSED collected snapshot id, time and device count (read for the page asked for)

name.description: keep the networks whose name contains this text (case-insensitive substring) or whose id is exactly this; the finding says how many networks and workspaces the login sees in all, so a capped page is never read as none

limit.description: networks per page: 50 by default, at most 200 (one call covers a login with up to 50 networks; a page says the next offset); view primary leaves the workspaces out
